title: Dagger
wikitext:
'''Daggers''' is an [[item class]] of one-handed [[melee]] [[weapons]] that require [[intelligence]] and [[dexterity]], have a high base [[critical strike chance]] and also have a {{c|mod|x% increased Global Critical Strike Chance}} [[implicit]] [[modifier]].

[[Maraketh weapon]]s with this item class have a {{c|mod|x% Chance to Block}} [[implicit]] instead.

Daggers are split into two categories: generic Daggers and [[Rune Daggers]]. The first kind cannot roll caster-related affixes, and Rune Daggers can roll all affixes.
